jobs.description:
Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?

Why this role exists

Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed. Over a million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes: automating tax tracking, surfacing deductions people didn't know they had, and connecting directly to the Danish tax authority to do it. We're an independent, profitable, 50-person company in central Copenhagen with a 4.7-star rating and one mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

None of that works without data people can trust. Our platform runs on Snowflake, Dagster and dbt, and we're investing further in it. We're looking for a data engineer who wants to own it: build it, run it and keep improving it, from infrastructure and ingestion down to the SQL.

If you're ready for the step up to senior and want a platform that's yours to own, not one you build and hand over, this is it.

The team works in English, so Danish isn't required. We're together in our Copenhagen office five days a week, with flexibility for the odd day at home when life calls for it.

What you'll be working on

• Ingestion, end to end. Get data from our source systems into Snowflake, and work with our product and platform teams on data contracts so pipelines hold up as those systems change.

• Orchestration in Dagster. Scheduling, dependencies, monitoring and recovering when things fail.

• Infrastructure as code. Snowflake environments, access and cost, managed in Terraform.

• dbt models and dbt Cloud. Turn raw data into well-tested data products, and run the environments, jobs and deployments behind them.

• How we use AI in the data stack. Help decide where it earns its place, and build it.

• Better practices. Testing, CI/CD, semantic modelling and performance on Snowflake.

• Over time, exposure to Java and our event-driven architecture.

What you bring

• 3+ years building data pipelines or data platforms.

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake and dbt, ideally in your current role.

• You've owned ingestion end to end, including the messy parts: source quirks, backfills, schema drift. You're more at home on the ingestion and platform side than in analytics and dashboards.

• Experience with orchestration (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect or similar), and you're fine being the one who gets paged when something breaks.

• You work well with engineers outside data and can turn product needs into data models.

Strong fundamentals matter more to us than having touched every tool in our stack. Terraform and dbt Cloud you can learn with us.

**Nice to have

**

• Infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

• dbt Cloud administration or DCM.

• Java or another OOP language, and event-driven architecture.

• Experience applying AI or LLMs within a data platform.

What we offer

• A platform you own long term. What you design ships, infrastructure included, and it stays yours. No handover, no next project.

• A modern stack, not legacy debt. Snowflake, Dagster, dbt Cloud, Terraform, Evidence and Lightdash, built recently and built to be extended.

• Close to product, not a data silo. Your input shapes what gets built upstream, not just what you transform downstream.

• A problem worth solving. Danish tax law is genuinely complex, and modelling it well is a real engineering challenge.

• Impact you can point to. Your pipelines and models power a product over a million Danes use to get their taxes right.

• Independent and profitable. No investor KPIs or heavy hierarchy; we answer to our users.

• A great spot in Copenhagen. Five minutes from Rådhuspladsen, lunch from Claus Meyer, and dinner covered when the day runs long.

Practical

• Location: Central Copenhagen, on-site five days a week

• Language: English (Danish not required)

• Salary: DKK 45,000–55,000 per month

• Pension: No employer-paid pension

• Start: As soon as possible

• Reports to: Head of Data & Operations Planning

Hiring process

• 30-minute online screening call with our recruiter.

• 1-hour on-site case session with the hiring manager and a team member.

• 30-minute on-site meet-and-greet with our CEO.

Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Product Manager (Agile Delivery) to d efine and manage the product vision, backlog, and execution of strategic initiatives. This role requires a strong ability to collaborate with stakeholders, prioritize feature development, and ensure the successful delivery of mobile connectivity solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience working with some major ISPs and device manufacturers, a deep understanding of Agile frameworks, and the ability to drive value for both customers and the business. As a small company with a startup spirit, we value innovation, agility, and a hands-on approach to problem-solving. We utilize  Scrum methodologies to ensure efficient and iterative product development.

You are the servant-leader who ensures the team adheres to Agile principles, remove blockers, and facilitate key meetings.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Define, develop, and manage the product roadmap aligned with company goals and customer needs.

• Design review and product testing before delivering to customers.

• Lead a cross-functional team to execute projects on time, within scope, and within budget with a collaborative and inclusive approach.

• Work closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and customers to ensure product success.

• Work in close collaboration with the Head of Product Management to ensure alignment with strategic initiatives and prioritization.

• Gather and analyze market trends, customer feedback, and competitive insights to inform product decisions.

• Establish and maintain project timelines, and deliverables.

• Identify risks and dependencies, providing proactive mitigation strategies.

• Communicate project status, challenges, and progress to stakeholders and leadership.

• Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success.

• Drive continuous improvement in product and project management processes.

**Qualifications & Skills

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, project management, or a similar role.

• Experience working with ISPs, device manufacturers, and mobile connectivity solutions is a plus.

• Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and other project management methodologies.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration.

• Proficiency in Scrum project management tools (e.g. Jira).

• Familiarity with software development processes and UX principles.

**Benefits

**

• Competitive remuneration package

• Health insurance

• Pension Scheme

• Flexi time, hybrid work

• Friendly office environment (pool table, darts board and gaming corner)

• Daily catered lunch, sodas, coffee, snacks, etc.

Join AXON Networks!

At AXON Networks, we promote equal opportunities in all our recruitment processes, ensuring non-discrimination on the basis of gender, age, origin, disability, or any other personal circumstances. We assess talent based on objective criteria and foster an inclusive and diverse working environment.

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

**The Role

**We are looking for an engineer passionate about building the next generation of high-scale audio processing infrastructure for communication centers that form a vital part of our critical infrastructure, including emergency dispatch centers and hospitals. You will be responsible for integrating AI capabilities into environments dominated by network protocols like SIP and SIPREC, ensuring robust and scalable performance at the heart of life-critical operations.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Architect and maintain systems processing over 100,000 calls per day.

• Develop foundational infrastructure using network protocols such as SIP and SIPREC.

• Integrate AI capabilities into low-latency, high-throughput audio processing pipelines.

• Collaborate with the Platform Engineering team with a commitment to engineering excellence to ensure system reliability and scalability.

• Hands-on development of an innovative solution where design choices matter

• Work with colleagues in design and code reviews

• Contribute to a strong culture of development at Corti through mentorship of developers of all levels

**What You Bring

**

• Master of Golang

• Deep understanding of network protocols, specifically SIP and SIPREC

• Proven track record of building and scaling foundational infrastructure

• Experience in ideating and implementing features with high complexity

• Hands-on experience with cloud computing architecture and development

• Experience running, monitoring, and operating REST, WebSockets, Kafka or an event-driven architecture

• Experience with containers and orchestration tools

• A passion for writing clean and efficient code

• Experience with WebSocket, gRPC and CockroachDB is a significant plus.

• Experience with real-time audio processing and WebRTC is a significant plus.

• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication

**Life at Corti

**

• You will be reporting to the Director of Platform Engineering.

• The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• Hybrid working environment in Copenhagen.

• Equipment provided by Corti

**Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Hit that 'Apply' button, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

**_🤝 Bringing in top talent from all backgrounds is crucial in our pursuit to improve the world of healthcare. We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status._At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

We are looking for a Product Manager to own charge point management for public CPOs on the Spirii platform. You will own the product area end-to-end and work across multiple teams, from charger connectivity and protocols to monitoring and device capabilities. You will shape the strategy, build the commercial case for it, and help drive its impact on revenue, margin and retention.

The Role

As Product Manager for Public CPOs, you will work closely with engineering, design and commercial teams to solve meaningful customer problems in ways that deliver business impact. You will shape the product vision, own an outcome-focused roadmap, and lead discovery based on evidence. You will also share your knowledge with other Product Managers and help build a strong, data-driven product culture across the organisation.

What You Will Do

• 
Vision & Strategy: Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for charge point management, and decide which problems are worth solving and which are not.

• 
Outcome-Focused Roadmapping: Prioritise initiatives based on customer value, business impact and feasibility.

• 
Discovery & Validation: Lead continuous discovery with customers, design and engineering. Test ideas early and use evidence, not assumptions, to make decisions.

• 
Commercial & Go-to-Market: Build business cases that tie your product area to ARR, gross margin and retention. Work with Sales, Marketing and Operations on pricing, packaging and go-to-market for charge point capabilities.

• 
Standards & Regulation: Follow standards and regulatory changes (OCPP 2.0.1/2.1, OCPI 2.3, AFIR) and turn them into roadmap decisions.

• 
Partnerships: Help shape integrations and partnerships with third-party hardware manufacturers for compatibility, scale and long-term flexibility.

• 
Delivery & Product Craft: Help your teams ship predictably, and write clear strategy docs, PRDs and customer communication.

• 
AI & Agentic Tools: Use agentic tools in your daily work, and share prompts, skills or workflows with other PMs.

• 
Stakeholder Communication: Communicate context, trade-offs and results clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, and use data to align priorities when they conflict.

• 
Knowledge Sharing: Support other Product Managers, share what you learn, and contribute to a collaborative product culture.

Qualifications

• 
5+ years in product management, ideally in EV charging, energy, IoT or B2B SaaS platforms, or equivalent domain depth.

• 
Experience owning a product or product area end-to-end, ideally across more than one team, with measurable results.

• 
Strong technical grounding in APIs, platforms and integrations. OCPP experience is a strong plus.

• 
Experience building business cases, and ideally working on pricing and packaging with commercial teams.

• 
Ability to influence across functions and seniority levels, including saying no with data.

• 
Hands-on experience with AI and agentic tools in your daily product work.

• 
Experience defining and tracking product metrics with tools like Mixpanel, Metabase, PowerBI or Datadog.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Who is the Customer Success Team?

Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

Currently, we are a team of 200+ people from 30+ nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learning from our mistakes, and growing together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

_Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!

**Your position

**In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg, Aarhus or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

**Your Tasks Will Include But Are Not Limited To

**

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS

• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443

• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations

• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities

• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration

• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position

• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders

• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

A key part of the role will be integrating CCTV AiNomaly with Global CCTV solution, based on Qognify. Together with the Global CCTV team, you will build the integrations and automated workflows that connect production footage with AI analysis and actionable results.

This is a hands-on development role with significant technical ownership. You will help set the architectural direction and write the code that brings it to life, from backend services and integrations to infrastructure, automated deployment and model execution.

Your responsibilities

• Design and develop the backend services and infrastructure supporting CCTV AiNomaly.

• Determine where and how AI vision models should run, balancing cloud and local processing with latency, connectivity, security and operational needs.

• Automate workflows for video processing, model deployment, inference and delivery of results.

• Develop and maintain integrations with the Qognify-based Global CCTV solution, enabling automated access to relevant footage for retrospective investigations and real-time analysis.

• Work with AI vision engineers to package and deploy models, manage versions and monitor their operation.

• Establish CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring and logging.

• Build for reliable daily operation through maintainable code, clear documentation and practical support procedures.

• Collaborate with production teams, Global CCTV colleagues and platform specialists to develop solutions that work on the shopfloor.

Required Skill/Experience/Education and Qualifications:

What you bring

You are an experienced backend developer who enjoys taking ownership and building a strong foundation for a growing product. You can make sound technical decisions, explain your choices and move from discussion to working software.

We expect you to bring:

• Strong backend development experience, preferably with .NET/C# and Azure.

• Experience designing APIs, integrating systems and building reliable services.

• Practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience operating software in production, including troubleshooting, monitoring and performance optimization.

• The ability to balance long-term architecture with pragmatic delivery.

• A collaborative approach and strong communication skills in English.

You do not need to be an AI researcher. Your core contribution will be the software engineering that makes AI models useful and dependable in production.

It would be an advantage if you have

• Experience deploying and running computer vision or machine learning models.

• Familiarity with Python, video processing, GPU workloads or edge computing.

• Knowledge of Qognify or similar video management systems, including integration of live video, recordings and event data.

About the team

You will join Digital Shopfloor, where we develop and operate digital products close to the production teams who use them. You will collaborate with AI specialists, software engineers and implementation colleagues, as well as our sister team responsible for Global CCTV.

This is an opportunity to shape a growing product, build its software foundation and help scale AI vision across production. Our purpose is to improve manufacturing performance and help more patients receive the treatments they need.

At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

**More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications

**

• At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.

• Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.

• Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

• Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.

• Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.

• Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.

What you will do

• Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.

• Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.

• Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.

• Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.

• Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices

• Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.

What we offer

• A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.

• A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.

• A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.

• A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.

• A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.

• A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.

How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

This role is an opportunity to help shape and lead a major transformation initiative within ABENA.

The Program Director – Digital Transformation will play a critical role in helping the organization evolve from multiple processes and legacy technology toward a more modern, efficient, and tech-enabled operating model.

ABENA is in the middle of a significant global business and digital transformation. We are standardizing core business processes, implementing SAP S/4HANA across markets and modernizing the technology platform that supports our global operations.

We are now looking for an experienced Global Program Director – Digital Transformation to take overall responsibility for driving this transformation forward.

This is a business transformation role with responsibility for bringing together business processes, governance, technology and execution across ABENA. You will report directly to the CEO in this newly established role and work closely with senior leaders across the organization.

Lead our global business and SAP transformation

The ONE Horizon program is ABENA’s global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. It includes the standardization of end-to-end business processes, SAP S/4HANA implementation across markets and the implementation of new warehouse management solutions.

As Global Program Director, you will have overall responsibility for driving the program and establishing the conditions for successful execution.

The transformation is already underway. You will therefore not be starting with a blank sheet of paper. Your responsibility will be to assess where we are, establish the structure and governance required to move forward, drive the necessary business decisions and ensure disciplined execution of the program.

We are looking for someone who has done this before; someone who understands the complexity of global SAP transformations, can challenge an organization constructively, and knows how to turn business decisions into execution.

A central part of the role will be to strengthen business ownership of the transformation. This includes clarifying and standardizing core end-to-end processes, establishing a strong Business Process Owner structure and ensuring that decisions are taken at the right level and followed through across the organization.

You will also lead and further develop the program management capability around the transformation. This includes formal leadership of a team of five direct reports. The current setup is still developing, and you will have the mandate to strengthen governance, roles, decision-making and program disciplines.

This role requires personal resilience, sound judgement and the ability to stay constructive and decisive in an environment where alignment will not always come easily.

Your key responsibilities

• Take overall responsibility for the execution of ABENA’s global ONE Horizon business and SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

• Establish and enforce effective program governance and create transparency on program scope, risks and delivery.

• Lead and develop the PMO team.

• Drive clarification, ownership and standardization of ABENA’s core end-to-end business processes across functions and markets, and personally facilitate complex cross-functional workshops and decision forums to create alignment and move critical issues forward.

• Establish and develop a strong global Business Process Owner network with clear accountability for process design, standards and business decisions.

• Work closely with IT as the key delivery organization, ensuring that business priorities, process decisions and technology delivery remain aligned throughout the transformation.

• Manage the balance between global process standardization and legitimate local business requirements.

• Drive organizational readiness, change management and adoption to ensure that new processes, systems and ways of working are embedded in the business.

Success in the role will be measured not simply by whether SAP is implemented, but by whether ABENA achieves clearer processes, stronger business ownership, disciplined execution and a scalable operating model across markets. As such, the Program Director role is one of the key building blocks of our future growth journey.

What we expect you to bring

You have substantial experience leading large-scale business and digital transformation programs in complex international organizations.

More specifically, we expect that you bring:

• Proven experience as Program Director, Transformation Director or equivalent, with end-to-end responsibility for major international transformation programs.

• Strong experience leading SAP S/4HANA implementations or rollouts across multiple countries or business units.

• Experience from an operationally complex business, ideally within manufacturing, sourcing, supply chain, distribution or logistics.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes and experience establishing effective program governance, including Business Process Owner structures, decision rights and escalation mechanisms.

• A proven track record of taking ownership of complex transformation programs where progress has been difficult and stakeholder alignment limited.

• The confidence and credibility to challenge senior stakeholders, hold difficult conversations and create alignment where interests, priorities and perspectives differ.

• Experience balancing global standards with legitimate local requirements.

• Practical understanding of structured SAP implementation approaches such as SAP Activate, combined with strong judgement and a clear bias towards execution.

• Clear and direct communication skills, sound judgement and a strong bias towards execution.

You are likely to succeed in this role if you combine strategic perspective with operational discipline, remain constructive under sustained pressure, and are comfortable taking ownership when there is no easy answer or immediate consensus.

Your Team, Our Culture and Values

Beyond leading the execution of the transformation program, you will lead and develop a small team of five program and project support specialists. Your task will be to create a high-performing team that drives and supports the execution of the program.

At ABENA, you join a global company with a strong purpose: to make a real difference in the everyday lives of people around the world. We combine professionalism with a warm, people-first culture where collaboration, curiosity and continuous improvement are necessary parts of everyday life. We take pride in delivering high-quality work with integrity, guided by our core values of trust, fairness and cooperation. These values shape how we lead, support one another and create meaningful impact for our customers and communities.

We look forward to receiving your application

If you are interested in the position, please send your CV as soon as possible. We review applications as we receive them and will close the search once we have found our new colleague.

Read more about our recruitment process here.

If you are curious to know more about the job, you are welcome to contact us. Please call +45 7431 1818 and ask for CEO Henrik Clausen.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our new Machine Learning Engineer

Machine learning is becoming an increasingly important part of how we understand energy markets, improve forecasts, and make trading decisions. We are therefore looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to move our models from research to production, building robust, scalable pipelines that continuously improve our strategies.

At Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET), we combine deep market expertise with machine learning, quantitative research, data, and engineering to automate and optimise how we trade power. We’re a small, highly ambitious team based in central Copenhagen, specialising in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is at the core of how we operate, supported by one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets.

The Opportunity

Energy markets produce vast amounts of data and are continuously shaped by weather, power production, transmission constraints, and market behaviour. Using that data meaningfully requires accurate models and reliable software and infrastructure that allow those models to run in production.

As our Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll work across machine learning and software development. Alongside quantitative researchers, software engineers and traders, you’ll build the production systems behind our ML pipelines, making our trading more performant, more reliable and more automated.

You’ll own the full lifecycle around the model: from data management to the pipelines and frameworks that deploy and monitor our models, keeping them reliable and adaptive as markets evolve. The opportunity for impact is large, and so is what it asks of you: dedication, real talent and the willingness to grind through hard problems. This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how CET uses machine learning to trade.

What You Will Do

• Strengthen our ML framework: Build and improve the framework our researchers use to build models and quantitative strategies.

• Build production-ready software: Design and develop reliable, scalable, and well-tested Python software that integrates machine learning into our internal trading platforms.

• Develop data infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and storage solutions for ingesting, transforming, and serving diverse market and fundamental data.

• Ship and operate models: Take models from experiment to production, including deployment, serving, monitoring and experiment tracking

• Improve our ML and engineering practices: Help strengthen our approach to MLOps, testing, CI/CD, code reviews, and the wider model development lifecycle.

• Shape our technical solutions: Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve how we develop, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions.

• Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to turn business and market needs into practical technical solutions.

• Build energy-market expertise: Develop a deep understanding of power markets and how machine learning, data, and software can improve trading decisions.

What We're Looking For

We value strong technical ability, sound judgement, curiosity, and motivation to learn. While we don't expect a perfect match, many of the following qualifications will help you succeed in the role:

• Strong software engineering skills: Experience building clean, scalable, tested, and production-ready software. Strong Python skills are essential, as Python is our primary development language.

• MLOps and development practices: Proficiency in Git, code reviews, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model deployment, and monitoring.

• Cloud computing: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, ideally including relevant data and machine learning services.

• Problem-solving and communication: The ability to structure complex problems, communicate clearly, and collaborate with colleagues across technical and commercial disciplines. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Interest in energy markets: Curiosity about power markets, trading, and energy systems. Previous experience in energy or trading is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• Education: A degree with a strong technical focus, e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other relevant fields. We welcome different educational backgrounds and levels of qualification.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Become part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive salary package and attractive benefits that reflect your skills and contributions.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, team-building, and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

How to Apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

Application deadline: November 27, 2026

If you have any questions, please contact Carl Frederik Grønvald (Senior Quantitative Analyst) at cfg@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann (People & Culture Manager) at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

Would you like to build the software that turns AI vision models into reliable tools for production? Join Digital Shopfloor and help us use video and AI to identify production issues, support investigations and improve manufacturing performance.

About the role

CCTV AiNomaly applies computer vision to production footage to help teams detect errors and understand when and where problems occur. We work with both retrospective video analysis and real-time detection.

As the first dedicated software developer on the product, you will play a central role in building its technical foundation. Working closely with our AI vision engineers, you will turn models and existing setups into software that can be deployed, monitored and maintained across production sites.

A key part of the role will be integrating CCTV AiNomaly with Global CCTV solution, based on Qognify. Together with the Global CCTV team, you will build the integrations and automated workflows that connect production footage with AI analysis and actionable results.

This is a hands-on development role with significant technical ownership. You will help set the architectural direction and write the code that brings it to life, from backend services and integrations to infrastructure, automated deployment and model execution.

Your responsibilities

• Design and develop the backend services and infrastructure supporting CCTV AiNomaly.

• Determine where and how AI vision models should run, balancing cloud and local processing with latency, connectivity, security and operational needs.

• Automate workflows for video processing, model deployment, inference and delivery of results.

• Develop and maintain integrations with the Qognify-based Global CCTV solution, enabling automated access to relevant footage for retrospective investigations and real-time analysis.

• Work with AI vision engineers to package and deploy models, manage versions and monitor their operation.

• Establish CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring and logging.

• Build for reliable daily operation through maintainable code, clear documentation and practical support procedures.

• Collaborate with production teams, Global CCTV colleagues and platform specialists to develop solutions that work on the shopfloor.

Required Skill/Experience/Education and Qualifications:

What you bring

You are an experienced backend developer who enjoys taking ownership and building a strong foundation for a growing product. You can make sound technical decisions, explain your choices and move from discussion to working software.

We expect you to bring:

• Strong backend development experience, preferably with .NET/C# and Azure.

• Experience designing APIs, integrating systems and building reliable services.

• Practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience operating software in production, including troubleshooting, monitoring and performance optimization.

• The ability to balance long-term architecture with pragmatic delivery.

• A collaborative approach and strong communication skills in English.

You do not need to be an AI researcher. Your core contribution will be the software engineering that makes AI models useful and dependable in production.

It would be an advantage if you have

• Experience deploying and running computer vision or machine learning models.

• Familiarity with Python, video processing, GPU workloads or edge computing.

• Knowledge of Qognify or similar video management systems, including integration of live video, recordings and event data.

About the team

You will join Digital Shopfloor, where we develop and operate digital products close to the production teams who use them. You will collaborate with AI specialists, software engineers and implementation colleagues, as well as our sister team responsible for Global CCTV.

This is an opportunity to shape a growing product, build its software foundation and help scale AI vision across production. Our purpose is to improve manufacturing performance and help more patients receive the treatments they need.
